test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A rectangular tin sheet is 17 cm long and 22 cm wide. It is rolled along its width to form a cylinder, with opposite edges just touching each other. Find the volume (in cm³) of the cylinder.
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the rectangular tin sheet = 17 cm.

Width of the rectangular tin sheet = 22 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = π × r² × h

Radius (r) = Width / (2π)

Height (h) = Length

**Calculation:**

Radius (r) = Width / (2π)

⇒ r = 22 / (2 × π)

⇒ r = 11 / π

Height (h) = 17 cm

Volume of cylinder = π × r² × h

⇒ Volume = π × (11 / π)² × 17

⇒ Volume = π × (121 / π²) × 17

⇒ Volume = (121 × 17) / π

⇒ Volume = 2057 / π

**The volume of the cylinder is (2057/π) cm³.**
